title: [FEATURE] Allow Claude Code Web to start sessions from branches other than default branch
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

Currently, Claude Code Web can only start coding sessions from the default branch. This becomes a limitation for individuals and teams using structured workflows like **GitFlow** or other multi-branch strategies. In such cases, the *main* branch is often several commits or even releases behind the *develop* branch or active feature branches.  
As a result, Claude Code Web lacks access to the most recent context, dependencies, and code changes that are relevant to ongoing development work.


### Proposed Solution

Allow users to **select which branch Claude Code Web should start from** before initiating a coding session.  
This could be implemented through a branch selector in the session start dialog.

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Priority

High - Significant impact on productivity

### Feature Category

Other

### Use Case Example

In many modern development workflows, it is common for multiple branches to be active simultaneously, each addressing different aspects of the project:

- A *feature/payments-integration* branch may introduce new API endpoints and transaction logic that are not yet part of the main codebase. Starting Claude Code Web from this branch would ensure access to the most relevant feature-specific context.

- A *hotfix/login-timeout* branch might exist to resolve an urgent production issue. Starting from this branch allows work to proceed against the stable production code without interference from ongoing development changes.

- A *develop* branch often contains general updates, dependency upgrades, and integrated work from multiple contributors. Starting Claude Code Web from this branch would provide an up-to-date view of the project’s development status before releasing.

The ability to start Claude Code Web from any of these branches would make it easier to maintain accurate context and deliver more relevant code assistance across concurrent development efforts.

### Additional Context

This capability would represent a competitive advantage over GitHub Copilot agents directly on github.com, where users have been requesting similar functionality (starting from non-*main* branches) for a long time — but it still hasn’t been implemented properly and only with workarounds.
